title: Normalized solutions to critical and supercritical Schrödinger equations in a ball
summary: In this paper, we study radial normalized solutions to nonlinear Schrödinger equations in the unit ball \[ -Δu+λu=|u|^{p-1}u, \qquad \int_{B_1}|u|^2\,dx=ρ, \] where $λ$ is unknown and $p\ge p_c:=\frac{N+2}{N-2}$. Soave \cite{Soave} proved that for every $1 p_c$. Thus, in the radial class, the subcritical all masses phenomenon fails throughout the full Sobolev critical and supercritical range.
